summary.headline: House Calculations and Astrological Omens
summary.text: Astrological instructions for calculating the beginnings of the horoskopos, midheaven, twelfth place, and other houses from right-sphere ascensions, followed by omens involving Saturn, the luminaries, Moon, malefics, and benefics. Examples include the Turkish attack and the exile of Photius the patriarch.
